faqs.question: What is a normal adult weight range for a American Curl?
faqs.answer: This breed record lists 5-10 lb (2.3-4.5 kg). Your veterinarian sets the target for the individual using body condition, not only the breed average.

faqs.question: Which health issues should I watch for in a kitten American Curl?
faqs.answer: This stage guide highlights Ear cartilage care (not infection by default); Dental disease; Patellar luxation. Use the linked symptom pages for red flags, then contact your clinic.

faqs.answer: Every 1-2 weeks on the same scale while a American Curl is growing, with the number saved beside vaccine dates.
